references.label: Lower-left time target
references.description: Standup that builds Bonus X, then lights for a ten-unit time award.
references.context: The lower-left standup builds Bonus X and restores time.

references.label: Three colored drop banks
references.description: Banks that score the current circular value, add Bonus, and restore time when completed.
references.context: The three drop banks add Bonus and can stop the clock.

references.label: Upper-left time channel
references.description: Channel lit for ten time units after all three banks are completed on one ball.
references.context: The upper-left channel restores ten time units when lit.

references.label: Three top yellow lanes
references.description: Linked top lanes whose completion awards three time units and stops the clock.
references.context: The yellow lanes can restore three time units and stop the clock.

references.label: Lower-right bullseye
references.description: Recessed target that adds bonus and may award time or Special at zero.
references.context: The right bullseye is a high-risk bonus and emergency-time target.

references.label: Circular target-value ladder
references.description: Playfield ladder from 100 through 800 whose wrap raises Bonus X.
references.context: The target-value ladder wraps from 800 to 100 and raises Bonus X.
